basic_info.description:
Elegant top-floor condo in Cow Hollow with two generous decks and amazing views! 1 Bed, 1 Bath. Full kitchen, washer/dryer, private entrance, & 1 garage parking spot. Quiet, private, and centrally-located near Marina, Pac Heights, & The Presidio - walk to cafes, grocery stores, restaurants, and Muni. Front deck has sweeping Bay views (including of Alcatraz!), industrial heat lamps, and tons of space for couches, chairs, and table. The back deck has unobstructed views of green scenery and enough space for BBQ, table and chairs. The apartment also comes with small lockable storage closet in the garage (next to the parking spot), a shared backyard, a digital front-gate entry system with camera and voice communication to upstairs. Tenant pays for utilities. 3 unit building.

12 month minimum lease. Tenant pays utilities. Owner pays water and garbage.
